answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 121 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is written down against the ripple challenge, the wander audit can replay the basalt history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 1918 identities would post 3981 proofs and burn roughly 7 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
